rationale: Motor vehicle collision with a totaled vehicle and documented injuries to the policyholder; clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at approximately 8:15am yesterday by an unbraking vehicle traveling ~35 mph. The policyholder's vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and rear-seat damage. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist and has the other driver's insurance information from the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: entire trunk crushed into back seat, vehicle totaled
